High-resolution (600 dpi) image of strangewayes' print-ready copy of the Players Committee virtual card [[Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm (V)]] (Virtual Set 5, Light Side), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]].

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Virtual Cards/Set 5/Light/Tatooine Lars Moisture Farm.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/1v3SJ8CwTLjJ_udaTI2au26t7N4DyyMBZ/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>Tatooine Lars Moisture Farm.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,338,776 bytes, SHA-256 <code>fcc131f74df9d56c3a02703467f22a1abdabdd1e891d5d4379b23322c83ebae3</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the image, 45.5, 47.0, 74.0, 56.5 px); resized: no; no other change.

The regular face of this card on its article stays [[:File:V5-L-tatooinelarsmoisturefarm-2018-07-08.gif]].
